description: This file defines Kubernetes custom resource types for a 'Carp' object, including its status, specification, conditions, and list, with associated metadata and deep copy generation annotations.

classes.name: Carp
classes.description: A custom resource representing a collection of containers with associated metadata, spec, and status.

classes.name: CarpStatus
classes.description: Holds current status information about a Carp, including phase, conditions, IPs, start time, and infos.

classes.name: CarpCondition
classes.description: Represents a condition of a Carp, including type, status, timestamps, reason, and message.

classes.name: CarpInfo
classes.description: Contains key-value data associated with a Carp, with keys A, B, and optional C.

classes.name: CarpSpec
classes.description: Specifies configuration details for a Carp, including restart policy, termination grace, node selector, and scheduling options.

classes.name: CarpList
classes.description: A list type for holding multiple Carp objects.
